improvements: Replace the incomplete zodToJsonSchema() in src/runtime/cli.ts with the zod-to-json-schema library. This fixes both the TYPE_SAFETY issues (unsafe casts into Zod _def internals across cli.ts and analyzer/index.ts) and the INCOMPLETE issue (missing ZodOptional, ZodNullable, ZodUnion, ZodArray, ZodEnum support). Impact: eliminates a class of runtime bugs where unsupported Zod types silently produce wrong JSON schemas sent to Claude. Effort: ~1 hour — install zod-to-json-schema, replace the custom function, remove the unsafe casts, update tests.

Extract the duplicated StepDef|StepBuilder resolution pattern from src/control/branch.ts, loop.ts, and map.ts into a shared utility (e.g. src/control/resolve-step.ts). This addresses the INCONSISTENCY and DUPLICATION issues and makes adding new control-flow nodes less error-prone. Impact: reduces maintenance burden and prevents divergence bugs when the resolution logic changes. Effort: ~30 minutes — extract helper, update three files, run tests.

Add structured error handling in src/loader/yaml.ts for loadYaml() (fs.readFileSync) and parseYamlString() (js-yaml parse), and in src/testing/benchmark.ts for pipeline.run(). Wrap each in try-catch and throw typed errors (e.g. LoaderError, BenchmarkRunError) with clear messages. Impact: prevents raw stack traces from reaching users and stops a single failed benchmark run from killing the entire suite. Effort: ~45 minutes — add error classes, wrap three call sites, add error-path tests.
